item.description:
Blinky 1.5.48

  • Grok Bot can sign in without Cursor installed. Under Settings → Providers → Grok Bot → Connection, sign in through Cursor's page; when a saved login has expired or been refused, Sign in again is on that row, and an unreadable store is not replaced by another login. Thanks to @sunny0826 for the contribution.
  • JetBrains AI can sign in to a JetBrains account. From IDE 2026.3, which no longer saves the quota on this Mac, sign in under Settings → Providers → JetBrains AI → Connection and Blinky asks JetBrains; “the IDE saved no quota” and “no limits” stay different. Thanks to @tyler4400 for reporting it.
  • sub2api and New API can add more accounts. Under Settings → Providers, open that provider's Accounts and choose Add another account; each account has its own address, API key and name. Thanks to @iblueer for the suggestion.
  • An idle usage window starts once. With Start a new window on for Claude Code or Codex, a window that is not already counting down gets one “hi”; a failed send is notified once, and nothing is sent again while a countdown is running. Thanks to @tyler4400 for the contribution.
  • The robot in the ring can be fluffy. The figures are Open Bot Avatar 0.4.0. Under an account's Appearance, set Material to Fluffy and the coat is drawn with Metal; Flat stays the default.
  • Antigravity's Gemini 4 Argon trial is priced. gemini-4-argon-trial in Token spend is estimated at Gemini 4 Argon's rates.
  • Antigravity does not offer another account. Adding one would use an OAuth route that breaks Antigravity's terms, so Settings has no such row.
  • Settings and status text is shorter. The same shortening is in all six languages.
